senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. צוּף) [to shine; cmp. צוּץ,] to look, esp. to look into distances of space or time; to foresee; to have a vision.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 24b:4">Meg. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>הרבה צָפוּ למרכבה וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>צִפּוּ לדרוש במ׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) many looked out for the Merkabah (v. <cite ref="M02700"><he>מֶרְכָּבָה</he></cite>), and never lived to see it; (ed. hoped to be able to preach on the Merkabah; Tosef. ib. III (IV), 28 <he>הרבה דרשו במ׳</he>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79:6">Gen. R. s. 79</cite> <he>צ׳</he> … <he>ברוח הקדש וכ׳</he> R. S. b. Y. saw by means of the spirit of holiness (inspiration) &c.; Y. Shebi. IX, 38ᵈ; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:8:1">Koh. R. to X, 8</cite>; Pesik. Vayhi, p. 90ᵃ.
<cite ref="Sotah 12b:12">Sot. 12ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>והמצפצפים</he> <cite ref="Isaiah 8:19">Is. VIII, 19</cite>) <he>צוֹפִין ואינן … צופין</he> they see (have a vision) and know not what they see.
Tosef. Pes. II (III), 12 [belonging to 13] איזהוּ צוֹפֶה הרואה וכ׳ who is called a tsofeh (a pilgrim that sees Jerusalem)? He who sees it and never loses it out of sight again.

<cite ref="Megillah 14a:12">Meg. 14ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>הרמתים צופים</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 1:1">I Sam. I, 1</cite>) <he>שתי רמות שצוֹפוֹת זו את זו</he> two heights that look at each other; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19:3">Num. R. s. 19</cite>, a. e. <cite ref="R00220"><he>צופים</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="R00667"><he>צָף</he></cite>.]—V. <cite ref="R00219"><he>צוֹפֶה</he></cite>, <cite ref="R00220"><he>צוֹפִים</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <he>צָפוּי</he>

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:15">Ab. III, 15</cite> <he>הכל צ׳ והרשות וכ׳</he> everything is foreseen (every deed of man is observed by God before whom there is no distance of space or time), but freedom of will is granted. Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 5 <he>שהיה צ׳ לפני וכ׳</he> it was foreseen before the Lord that they would come &c. Ib. 9 <he>שהכל צ׳ וכ׳</he> (omit <cite ref="E00230"><he>היה</he></cite>) for every event is foreseen by the Lord; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Berakhot 57b:6">Ber. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>יְצַפֶּה לחסידות</he> may hope to attain piety.
<cite ref="Pesachim 50b:6">Pes. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>המְצַפֶּה לשכר אשתו</he> he who looks forward to (is dependent on) his wife’s earnings.
<cite ref="Beitzah 32b:6">Bets. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>המצפה לשלחן חבירו</he> who depends on his neighbor’s table.

<cite ref="Beitzah 32b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>המצפה על שולחן וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) Ruth. R. introd. (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 13:4">Ez. XIII, 4</cite>) <he>מה שועל הזה מצפה בחורבות וכ׳</he> as the fox in the ruins looks out, when he sees men pass by, which way to flee &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 352:1">Yalk. Ez. 352</cite> <he>יושב ומצעה</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74:1">Gen. R. s. 74</cite> <he>אביך מצפה לך אמך מְצַפָּה לך</he> thy (dead) father looks forward to thy coming, thy mother &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cover with shining plate, to overlay.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 27a:1">R. Hash. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>צִיפָּהוּ זהב וכ׳</he> if he overlaid the Shofar at the place where the mouth is applied; Y. ib. III, 58ᵈ; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְצוּפֶּה</he>, f. <he>מְצוּפָּה</he> &c. Ib. III, 3 <he>ופיו מצ׳ זהב</he> and its mouthpiece was covered with gold.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 3:8">Ḥag. III, 8</cite> <he>מפני שהן מְצוּפִּין</he> because they (the altars) are overlaid (with gold or copper); a. fr.
